### 1 — Scene
Two small bowls: cooked mixed vegetables and a leafy salad with dark olives and apparent white cheese cubes. Both bowls are included in the meal.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Vegetable bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**.
- **Salad bowl:** approximately 18 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 9² = **254 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Broccoli, carrots, sweetcorn, green beans, leafy greens, dark olives, and apparent white cheese. No distinct oil or dressing is clearly visible, so none is added.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage percentages refer to each food’s own bowl. Volumes describe the outer envelope; bulk density is the only allowance for gaps.

| Item | Bowl area covered | Area (cm²) | Height (cm) | Volume (ml) | Density (g/ml) | Weight (g) | kcal/100 g | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Broccoli | 18% | 57 | 1.9 | 108 | 0.55 | 59 | 35 | 21 |
| Carrots | 14% | 44 | 1.7 | 75 | 0.60 | 45 | 35 | 16 |
| Sweetcorn | 7% | 22 | 1.7 | 37 | 0.65 | 24 | 96 | 23 |
| Green beans | 6% | 19 | 1.7 | 32 | 0.60 | 19 | 35 | 7 |
| Leafy greens | 55% | 140 | 2.5 | 350 | 0.15 | 53 | 17 | 9 |
| Dark olives | 5% | 13 | 1.0 | 13 | 0.65 | 8 | 145 | 12 |
| White cheese, likely feta | 5% | 13 | 0.6 | 8 | 1.00 | 8 | 265 | 21 |

**Coverage check:** vegetables cover approximately **45%** of their bowl’s full area; salad ingredients cover approximately **65%** of theirs. The remaining area is mainly exposed rim and bowl interior.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate totals **216 g and about 109 kcal**. This is plausible for a modest vegetable portion and a loosely piled salad with only a few olives and cheese pieces. Any unseen dressing would increase the energy estimate.
